name: Thanksgiving
description: Gravy, football and the kids' table.

easy: a parade balloon on the loose
medium: The turkey is still frozen in the middle.
Uncle Ray brought up the map again.
The gravy has developed a skin.
Somebody sat on the pumpkin pie.
I was told there would be rolls.
The dog got the drumstick fair and square.
We ran out of chairs, so I'm on a cooler.
Save room for the second dessert table.
That's the good china, not a frisbee.
The oven timer has been beeping since noon.
I only came for the sweet potatoes.
Nobody touch the thermostat this year.
hard: Every year the turkey gets bigger and the oven stays exactly the same size.
Let's go round the table and hear what everyone did with my casserole dish.
The parade was fine until the giant squirrel balloon drifted into our street.
My aunt hides the good pie in the laundry room and thinks nobody knows.
We deep-fried the turkey once and the fence has never forgiven us.
I fell asleep during the game and woke up holding somebody else's plate.
The kids' table has unionised and is demanding a later bedtime.
Grandma measures the butter with her heart and the salt with her elbow.
There are eleven side dishes and somehow nine of them are beige.
I'm not saying the stuffing was dry, but the dog asked for a glass of water.
